data.one_liner: VdoCipher plugin for secure video playback in Flutter apps across Android, iOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a VdoPlayer widget and controller to stream VdoCipher‑protected videos. Handles DRM, playback controls, and event callbacks on all supported platforms.
use_when: building a cross‑platform app that must play VdoCipher content
avoid_when: simple local video playback without DRM
requiring extensive UI customization of the player
strengths: exposes playback controls and event listeners
data.setup_notes: Add Android Theme.AppCompat and extend FlutterFragmentActivity; integrate iOS VdoCipher SDK; no extra build_runner steps.

alternatives.name: video_player
alternatives.why_pick_it: general purpose video playback without DRM, more UI flexibility
